# Foundations {#foundations}

::: {.analysis-subtitle}
What data is, and how to look at it
:::

Before any method comes a prior question: what *is* the thing being analysed, and how did it come to exist? Every number in this book was produced by somebody deciding to measure something, and that decision — what to count, whom to ask, what to leave out — is already an interpretation.

This chapter sets up the two habits the rest of the book depends on. The first is asking where a measurement came from and what it quietly excludes. The second is looking at it, because a figure that has been thought about carefully will tell you in seconds what a table hides for hours.
